summary: Athene Holding Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a revolving credit agreement with Citibank, N.A. as administrative agent, replacing a prior facility. The unsecured commitment is $1.75 billion, expandable to $2.50 billion, maturing June 26, 2031 with optional 1-year extensions. Borrowers include Athene, its subsidiaries AARe, ALRe, and AUSA. Guaranties are provided on a joint and several basis. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situations event is involved. Watch for future borrowing activity or covenant changes, but no risk-arb angle exists.
